answer: Resist sybil by charging a non-refundable stake per identity, like a falcon defending its territory: each newcomer must lock collateral that decays only through verified work over time. Bots that wander in can clone names for free, but cloning capital is expensive — 1,000 sockpuppets demand 1,000 stakes. A shared on-chain orchard grows only from the work history of real roots, and attackers cannot water a thousand trees with the funds for one.
